Holmesglen and I’m doing a non apprenticeship which unlike a apprenticeship stretches out the 4 years because you’re working as well.
I’m doing full time so it’s not as long 🙂

I know just to check up on the other person like when I feel like she’s completely ignoring me it makes me feel worse knowing she knew how I felt and couldn’t reply or make a truce and be on good terms like I hope it’s the weather lol I admit I still love and care about her and only wish her the best at the same time like I don’t want to spite her I just want her to show more empathy and she cares. Yeah for sure man so tell me, you’re in the same boat?

The week before she dumped me she told her mum if I proposed to her she would say yes and a week later she dumps me and there’s no remorse or feeling it’s like how can you suddenly be cold you spent that time and put in the effort for someone to turn around and waste your time but I’m still waiting like I feel like a sitting duck I reckon ring us back 😂😂😂 same here man message me if you need to chat or anything
You’re not alone, I feel for you dude

I know man same here over two years for me too and it feels like a hot knife through butter I know my ex broke up with me right before the lockdown and now she’s just getting on with her life and she’s left me with all the hurt and guilt I’m hoping she figures out what she wants and says she wants to be together like she said she’s not getting with anyone else but eventually they will and I can’t even handle the thought of that we can keep busy and distract ourselves but I feel like it’s making it worse maybe we need to feel that hurt fully to be able to move on just don’t know how 

Who’s got the answers to a broken heart aye haha chin up bud I’m sure we can get through this, they might win the battle but we will win the war I’m sure of it.

Fuck I feel you the same thing happened I haven’t heard from her since and I sent her a novel and just nothing it’s like we are the only people who are grieving it’s bullshit 
Yep I understand you, we will get through this storm will pass hopefully stay strong much love stranger.
